title: SecretSifter: A Runtime Secret-Detection Engine for Live Web Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2611.28168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Credentials embedded in client-delivered web artifacts, such as minified JavaScript bundles, webpack chunks, server-side-rendered state objects, and JSON or XML API responses, form a runtime attack surface that repository-time (shift-left) secret scanners do not observe, because the credential enters the served artifact at build time or at runtime, after every source-code gate has passed. This paper presents SecretSifter, an open-source runtime secret-detection engine that inspects live web traffic and reports secret-grade credentials at the point they are delivered to the browser. The engine combines format-anchored and context-gated detection rules, semantic key-name extraction, Shannon-entropy scoring, and dedicated detection of hardcoded CryptoJS/AES material across the full served surface. SecretSifter ships as three editions over one shared detection core: a Burp Suite extension, a Chrome extension, and a standalone Windows and mac

translated_title: SecretSifter：面向实时Web流量的运行时密钥检测引擎
translated_abstract: 嵌入在客户端交付的Web工件（如压缩后的JavaScript包、webpack代码块、服务端渲染的状态对象以及JSON或XML API响应）中的凭证，构成了一种仓库时（左移）密钥扫描器无法观测到的运行时攻击面，因为这些凭证是在构建时或运行时进入所交付工件的，此时所有源代码门禁检查均已通过。本文提出了SecretSifter，一个开源的运行时密钥检测引擎，它检查实时Web流量，并在密钥级凭证被交付到浏览器的时刻进行报告。该引擎结合了格式锚定与上下文门控的检测规则、语义化密钥名称提取、香农熵评分，以及对硬编码CryptoJS/AES密钥材料的专项检测，覆盖完整的交付面。SecretSifter基于同一个共享检测核心提供三个版本：Burp Suite扩展、Chrome扩展以及独立的Windows和mac（OS应用）。
tldr: SecretSifter是一个开源的运行时密钥检测引擎，通过组合格式锚定与上下文门控规则、语义化密钥名提取、香农熵评分以及CryptoJS/AES硬编码专项检测，在实时Web流量中于凭证交付到浏览器的时刻发现密钥级凭证，填补了传统左移式仓库扫描器无法覆盖的运行时攻击面。
en_tdlr: SecretSifter is an open-source runtime secret-detection engine that inspects live web traffic and reports secret-grade credentials at the point of browser delivery, combining format-anchored and context-gated rules, semantic key-name extraction, Shannon-entropy scoring, and dedicated CryptoJS/AES detection to cover the runtime attack surface that shift-left repository scanners cannot observe.
